تتدافعوا (form VI)
# تَتَدَافَعُوا (tatadāfaʕū) /ta.ta.daː.fa.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَدَافَعَ (tadāfaʕa)
# تُتَدَافَعُوا (tutadāfaʕū) /tu.ta.daː.fa.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَدَافَعَ (tadāfaʕa)
